changes.name: Death Dealer Ray

details.before: Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and has a 100% chance to put them to sleep for 1 turn and inflict venom for 2 turns.
details.after: Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and has a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects and sleep for 1 turn.

details.before: Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and a 100% chance to inflict sleep for 1 turn and venom for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.
details.after: Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies, and has a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects and sleep for 1 turn. Grants an extra turn.

details.before: Cancer
details.after: Scorpio

changes.summary: Death Dealer Ray is a Hero who subdues enemies with Venom and Sleep, but there were cases where enemy debuff-dispelling skills could remove Sleep somewhat easily.

changes.name: Requiem Roana

details.before:
Attacks the enemy with magic, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.
details.after:
Attacks the enemy with magic, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.

details.before:
Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling one buff before increasing cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, but penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.
details.after: Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling two buffs before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense.

details.before:
Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling one buff before increasing cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, but penetrates the target's Defense.
details.after:
Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling two buffs before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense.
When the target is a Hero, damage dealt increases proportional to the target's current Health.

changes.summary: With this improvement, Requiem Roana's ability to dispel buffs and deal damage will be strengthened. First, Touch of Darkness will have its base damage and Soulburn damage decreased, while its additional damage proportional to Attack will be increased.

changes.name: Eternal Wanderer Ludwig

details.before: Attacks all enemies with the essence of magical engineering. When someone uses a Soulburn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% and penetration rate of this skill by 30%. Penetration rate increase effect can stack up to 2 times.
details.after: Attacks all enemies with the essence of magical engineering. When someone uses a Soulburn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% and Defense penetration of this skill by 35%. Penetration increase effect can stack up to 2 times.

changes.summary: Eternal Wanderer Ludwig's Defense penetration will be strengthened, allowing him to deal more powerful damage to enemies with high Defense. The penetration rate increase of Can You Handle This? will be increased from 30% to 35%, increasing its Defense penetration at two stacks from 60% to 70%.

changes.name: Hellion Lua

details.before: After being attacked by a Hero, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 10% and triggers a counterattack from all allies granted challenge.
details.after: After being attacked by a Hero, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 15% and triggers a counterattack from all allies granted challenge.

details.before:
- +1% Combat Readiness
- +1% Combat Readiness
- +1% Combat Readiness
details.after:
- +1% Combat Readiness
- +2% Combat Readiness
- +2% Combat Readiness

details.before:
Grants challenge to all allies, before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns.
Has a 100% chance to provoke all enemies for 1 turn.
details.after:
Grants challenge to all allies, before granting increased Defense to the caster for 2 turns.
Has a 100% chance to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns and provoke for 1 turn on all enemies.

details.before:
Grants challenge to all allies, before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns.
Decreases buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and has a 100% chance to provoke for 1 turn.
details.after:
Grants challenge to all allies, before granting increased Defense to the caster for 2 turns.
Decreases buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and has a 100% chance to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns and provoke for 1 turn.

changes.summary: Hellion Lua will be improved to withstand enemy attacks more reliably and trigger counterattacks from allies.

changes.name: Summertime Iseria

details.before: Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, decreasing Attack for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the enemy.
details.after: Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, inflicting decreased Attack and decreased Defense for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

details.before: Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, decreasing Attack for 2 turns and increases Speed of the caster for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the enemy.
details.after: Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, inflicting decreased Attack and decreased Defense for 2 turns, and granting increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

changes.summary: Summertime Iseria will be improved with the addition of Decrease Defense, allowing her to support allied attacks more effectively. Sword of Flowers! will be changed to inflict decreased Defense on all enemies in addition to decreased Attack, allowing allies to deal more powerful damage to enemies.

changes.name: Guard Captain Krau

details.before: Attacks the enemy with a mystic blade and deals additional damage. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% . Damage dealt and additional damage increase proportional to the caster's Defense.
details.after: Attacks the enemy with a mystic blade and deals additional damage. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25% . Damage dealt and additional damage increase proportional to the caster's Defense.

details.before:
After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.
details.after:
After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health.
Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

changes.summary: Guard Captain Krau will be improved so that he can play a more active role in battle. First, Crimson Flame will have its Combat Readiness increase raised from 20% to 25%, allowing him to take turns more quickly. Its additional damage will also be increased.

changes.name: Victorika

details.before: Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.
details.after: Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.

details.before: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines.
details.after: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns.

details.before: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants counterattack to the caster for 3 turns.
details.after: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants a barrier (proportional to Attack) and counterattack to the caster for 2 turns.

details.before: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.
details.after: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

changes.summary: Victorika's offensive capabilities and survivability will both be strengthened. First, Hilag's Pride will have its damage increased, strengthening her basic attack.
